features.title: Turbo
features.description: Splits one message into parts that run at the same time. The Timeline page shows them side by side.
features.where: Under the message box of a new chat (the + on Chats)

features.title: Next up
features.description: What you ask for in a chat lines up and starts by itself when a session finishes. Move it, pause it or take it off.

features.title: Agents in a terminal
features.description: Run an agent in its own terminal next to your chats. It keeps running when Dispatch closes and comes back with its screen.
features.where: Press ⌘T, or New Terminal in a project's + menu

features.title: Settings in one place
features.description: Accounts and usage, agents, notifications, keep awake and what agents can use, all in the side bar.
features.where: Press ⌘, or click Settings at the bottom left
